LanguageData.LP_Rage.label: rage
LanguageData.LP_Rage.description: Fly into a rage for 30 seconds: melee damage ×(1.15 + 0.1 × rage power), sharp and blunt damage taken (including bullets) ×0.7; cannot use spellcasting class abilities while raging. Costs 1 rage. Barbarian level 1.
LanguageData.LP_RecklessAttack.label: reckless attack
LanguageData.LP_RecklessAttack.description: Attack recklessly for 15 seconds: melee hit +20%, your own melee dodge -20%. Costs no rage. Barbarian level 3.
LanguageData.LP_DangerSense.label: danger sense
LanguageData.LP_DangerSense.description: Passive: while not downed, incoming bullets have a 15% × rage power (up to 30%) chance to be dodged completely; explosion damage ×0.5. Barbarian level 5.
LanguageData.LP_PrimalRoar.label: primal roar
LanguageData.LP_PrimalRoar.description: A bestial roar: enemies within radius 6 × rage power are shaken for 10 seconds; non-boss humanlikes and animals also have a 40% × rage power (up to 80%) chance to flee in fear. Costs 1 rage. Cooldown 1 hour. Barbarian level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BrutalCritical.label: brutal critical
LanguageData.LP_BrutalCritical.description: Passive: melee hits have a 15% chance (25% while raging) to land a brutal critical, dealing ×2 damage. Barbarian level 10.
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessRage.label: relentless rage
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessRage.description: Passive: while raging, when you would fall, fury holds you up for another 10 seconds (no pain, won't fall); only once per rage, and if the injuries remain after 10 seconds you fall as usual. Barbarian level 13.
LanguageData.LP_PrimalChampion.label: primal champion
LanguageData.LP_PrimalChampion.description: Passive: Strength +4 (applied after the ability cap, like combat gifts), rage no longer decays over time. Barbarian level 15, also requires Melee 15.
LanguageData.LP_FavoredFoe.label: favored enemy
LanguageData.LP_FavoredFoe.description: Passive: choose a favored enemy (dragons, giants, undead, fiends, aberrations, beasts, divine, humanlikes or mechanoids; pick with the "choose favored enemy" button when drafted). Against the favored enemy: damage +20%, melee hit +20%, shooting hit ×1.2. At ranger level 10 you may choose another. Ranger level 1.
LanguageData.LP_RangerMark.label: hunter's mark
LanguageData.LP_RangerMark.description: Mark one enemy within 30 cells for 1 hour: you deal ×(1 + 0.15 × hunter power) damage to it. No resource cost. Ranger level 3.
LanguageData.LP_Woodstride.label: land's stride
LanguageData.LP_Woodstride.description: Passive: movement slowdown from terrain, snow and plants reduced by 75%. Ranger level 5.
LanguageData.LP_Volley.label: volley
LanguageData.LP_Volley.description: Volley at a point within weapon range: every enemy within radius 3 (up to 6) takes one guaranteed-hit bullet from your current weapon at ×0.8 × hunter power damage. Requires a ranged weapon, no resource cost. Ranger level 7.
LanguageData.LP_BeastBond.label: beast companion
LanguageData.LP_BeastBond.description: Passive: animals whose master is you (on the same map) get the beast companion state: melee damage ×(1.1 + 0.1 × hunter power), movement ×1.1, armor +10% × hunter power, +20% damage against your favored enemy. You may also choose one more favored enemy. Ranger level 10.
LanguageData.LP_HideInPlain.label: hide in plain sight
LanguageData.LP_HideInPlain.description: Blend into the terrain for 20 seconds × hunter power: invisible; the next attack deals ×1.5 damage and reveals you. Cooldown 1 hour. Ranger level 13.
LanguageData.LP_FoeSlayer.label: foe slayer
LanguageData.LP_FoeSlayer.description: Passive: favored enemy bonuses doubled (damage +40%, melee hit +40%, shooting hit ×1.4). Ranger level 15, also requires Shooting 15.
LanguageData.LP_SneakAttack.label: sneak attack
LanguageData.LP_SneakAttack.description: Passive: when the target is downed, stunned, fleeing, not targeting you, or has one of your allies within 1.5 cells, your attacks deal ×(1 + (0.2 + 0.03 × (rogue level - 1)) × cunning power) damage; at most once per second. Both melee and ranged count. Rogue level 1.
LanguageData.LP_CunningAction.label: cunning action
LanguageData.LP_CunningAction.description: For 5 seconds × cunning power, movement ×1.6 and melee dodge +30%, for dashing or disengaging. Rogue level 3.
LanguageData.LP_UncannyDodge.label: uncanny dodge
LanguageData.LP_UncannyDodge.description: Passive: once every 10 seconds, one instance of ranged damage taken is halved. Rogue level 5.
LanguageData.LP_ShadowStep.label: shadow step
LanguageData.LP_ShadowStep.description: Melt into the shadows for 15 seconds × cunning power: invisible, revealed after attacking (attacking while invisible counts as a sneak attack). Rogue level 7.
LanguageData.LP_PoisonBlade.label: poisoned blade
LanguageData.LP_PoisonBlade.description: Coat your weapon in poison for 1 minute: every hit adds +6% × cunning power toxic buildup to the target (no effect on mechanoids and undead). Cooldown 1 hour. Rogue level 10.
LanguageData.LP_Assassinate.label: assassinate
LanguageData.LP_Assassinate.description: Resolve a melee hit on an adjacent enemy: if the target hasn't noticed you (isn't targeting you, or you're invisible) this hit deals ×(2 + cunning power) damage, otherwise ×1.5; sneak attack stacks as usual. Cooldown 1 minute. Rogue level 13.
LanguageData.LP_StrokeOfLuck.label: stroke of luck
LanguageData.LP_StrokeOfLuck.description: Passive: once per day, a melee attack that would miss hits instead, and that hit deals ×2 damage. Rogue level 15, also requires Melee 15.
LanguageData.LP_LegBerserkerSoul.label: berserker soul
LanguageData.LP_LegBerserkerSoul.description: Legendary passive: while raging, immune to stuns and mental breaks, melee cooldown ×0.85. Legendary barbarian.
LanguageData.LP_LegEarthShatter.label: earthshatter
LanguageData.LP_LegEarthShatter.description: Legendary: an axe blow splits the earth; enemies within radius 5 take 30 × rage power blunt damage and are stunned for 3 seconds. Costs 3 rage. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary barbarian.
LanguageData.LP_LegFoeBane.label: bane of the foe
LanguageData.LP_LegFoeBane.description: Legendary passive: attacks against your favored enemy always hit and deal +15% more damage. Legendary ranger.
LanguageData.LP_LegArrowStorm.label: arrow storm
LanguageData.LP_LegArrowStorm.description: Legendary: rain arrows on a point within weapon range; every enemy within radius 6 (up to 10) takes 3 guaranteed-hit bullets from your current weapon. Requires a ranged weapon. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary ranger.
LanguageData.LP_LegShadowDance.label: shadow dance
LanguageData.LP_LegShadowDance.description: Legendary passive: Sneak Attack no longer needs any condition and can trigger once every 0.5 seconds. Legendary rogue.
LanguageData.LP_LegDeathMark.label: death mark
LanguageData.LP_LegDeathMark.description: Legendary: mark one enemy within 30 cells for 30 seconds; you deal ×2 damage to it; if it dies under the mark, all your rogue abilities finish cooling down. Cooldown 1 day. Legendary rogue.
